description.narrative: The activities proposed are designed to provide an integrated and coherent response to the needs of 285 HHs (1425 p) among the displaced hosted by host families in Croix-des-Bouquets (CdB). CA and partners will coordinate with community leaders in host communities for implementation. Activities will include: - MPC: Two rounds of MPC will be provided to each of 103 HH in host communities in CdB. - WASH - Families will also receive individual storage containers and hygiene kits (2 storage containers once and 2 hygiene kits distribution cycles) containing essentials like soap, toothpaste, feminine hygiene items and baby products. Contracts with local suppliers will streamline kit distribution using secure coupons, minimizing transport risks. This comprehensive approach promotes hygiene, reduces disease transmission risks (e.g., cholera, diarrhoea), and ensures families have essential resources for maintaining health; - Throughout the project, protection will be mainstreamed: targeted individuals with additional protection needs will be supported to access specialized protection services (referral) throughout the program cycle. Individuals identified at displaced household level with protection needs will receive appropriate referrals. Collaborating with partners specializing in protection will ensure effective and rapid referral of beneficiaries to essential services. In coordination with the protection cluster and IBESR, particular attention will be paid to children in need of protection, such as unaccompanied children and orphans.
